blocks.text: Custom kitchens in Bratislava — design, planning, and manufacturing

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN is a design studio in Bratislava, Slovakia. We design and build custom kitchens for apartments, houses, and condos in Bratislava.
We handle the entire process: kitchen design, layout, 3D visualization, technical development, selection of materials and hardware, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
Custom kitchen design in Bratislava

Each kitchen is designed for a specific room and the client’s lifestyle. We take into account the room’s dimensions, the location of utility lines, built-in appliances, the amount of storage needed, the ergonomics of the work zones, and the overall interior style.
We design straight, L-shaped, and U-shaped kitchens, kitchens with an island, open-plan kitchen and living areas, and floor-to-ceiling built-in kitchens.
3D visualization and technical development

Before production begins, you can see your future kitchen in a realistic 3D visualization. This lets you agree in advance on the color of the fronts, the countertop, the lighting, the appliance placement, and the overall composition of the interior.

Once the design is approved, we prepare the technical documentation for production: the dimensions of the furniture modules, opening systems, interior fittings, and the placement of appliances, electrical wiring, plumbing, and accent lighting.
Custom kitchen manufacturing
Kitchens are made to custom dimensions. Fronts can be made of laminated chipboard, MDF, painted MDF, veneer, and other decorative materials.
Countertops are available in laminate, compact laminate, engineered quartz, ceramic, and artificial or natural stone.

The kitchen’s components are selected to suit the client’s requirements and budget. You can choose standard or more advanced furniture hardware, as well as materials ranging from more affordable to premium.
Built-in appliances and storage systems
From the outset, the kitchen design accounts for the refrigerator, oven, cooktop, dishwasher, range hood, and other built-in appliances.
We also include pull-out systems, cargo pull-outs, interior organizers, waste sorting systems, lift-up mechanisms, and other solutions for convenient storage.
Kitchens for apartments and houses in Bratislava

We create kitchens for modern apartments, new developments, and private homes in Bratislava. We pay special attention to open-plan kitchen and living areas, where the kitchen furniture needs to work together with the TV area, wall panels, cabinets, and other built-in furniture.
If needed, DUMSKAYA DESIGN can design all of the apartment’s built-in furniture in a single, cohesive style.
How the ordering process works
First, we discuss the client’s wishes and the existing conditions of the room. Then we take measurements, develop the kitchen layout and design, and select materials and hardware.
Once everything is approved, a technical design is prepared and the cost is calculated. The kitchen then goes into production, after which delivery and installation are arranged in Bratislava.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN Bratislava
We combine interior design and custom furniture manufacturing in a single project.
You can order just a kitchen or a complete solution for your apartment or house: interior design, a kitchen, built-in wardrobes, walk-in closets, wall panels, and other custom furniture.
Order a kitchen in Bratislava
Send us the floor plan or room dimensions, photos of the kitchen, and a few examples of designs you like. We will prepare a preliminary proposal and suggest a suitable way to bring it to life.
